decision_rule.held_out_band: compare observed queue wait and batching service separately with each inclusive frozen component band; publish every miss without widening
decision_rule.no_monotonic_rescore: do not compute or score total per-token delay direction; VLLM-40 already validated 250 to 8,000 requests/s
decision_rule.onset: for each of six configurations, report the first queue-dominated adjacent segment exactly as observed
decision_rule.vllm41_close: close only if all six configurations have a first queue-dominated segment strictly below 250 and at least one preceding non-queue-dominated segment
decision_rule.vllm42_residual: register any held-out quantitative component-band miss on VLLM-42
decision_rule.vllm43_residual: register differing first-onset segments across pool ratios or prompt lengths, or any configuration without a resolved onset, on VLLM-43

decomposition.arrival_to_prefill_wait: mean of prefill_eligible_at_ps minus admitted_at_ps over the 64 exact request timelines
decomposition.batching_service_per_token: sum imported S(batch) over every stock-scheduler decode batch, divided by the number of scheduled request-token visits
decomposition.handoff_to_decode_admission_wait: mean of decode_eligible_at_ps minus handoff.completed_at_ps over the same timelines
decomposition.scheduler_queue_wait: arrival-to-prefill wait plus handoff-to-decode admission wait; never add provider service to this field
decomposition.segment_comparison: divide the scheduler-wait delta by four output tokens, retain batching service per token separately, and mark queue-dominated only when the wait delta is positive and the separated component sum rises

held_out.union_rule: score a point as held out when its load or pool ratio is held out

preservation_locks.flagship_selection_rule: tracked deployment_curve_v1 basenames beginning flagship or RESULTS, plus every tracked figures member

queue_model.boundary_abstraction: prefill and handoff service are zero-cost phase boundaries in the numerical model; no comparator or observed delay enters the prediction
queue_model.driver_structure: one shared virtual clock chooses one nonempty prefill or decode engine in work-conserving round-robin order; decode requests retain four visits and each engine batches at most eight
queue_model.name: deterministic-shared-clock-round-robin-bulk-service-v1
numerical_inputs: logged imported batch-1 and batch-8 measured service and CV fields
queue_model.queue_dominated_segment: mean scheduler-wait increase divided by four exceeds any batching-service-per-token reduction, so their separated component sum increases

surface_uncertainty.rule: scale every interpolated batch service by plus or minus three times the maximum imported trimmed CV

queue_model.wait_band: take the min and max modeled wait across the surface scenarios, then add at most one upper batch-8 service residual at each of the two admission boundaries
